parameters.query:
=-- Resolve the caller's identity (Section 2.3 guest_sessions).
--
-- Phase 5 §5.5 fix: this used to INSERT a fresh guest row on *every*
-- request, which (a) minted a new id per request instead of a stable one
-- and (b) overwrote the identity of a signed-in user, so playlist export
-- could never find their oauth_accounts row. Now: an authenticated request
-- skips the insert and passes its users.id through, and a guest request
-- upserts on the guest_id Flask already sends -- the same id that
-- auth_google._link_guest_session() looks up at sign-in, which is what
-- makes guest->user migration possible at all.
--
-- The CTE shape matters: it always returns exactly one row. A bare
-- conditional INSERT would return zero rows for authenticated users, and
-- an n8n node that emits no items stops the branch dead.
WITH input AS (
  SELECT NULLIF('{{ $('Validate Request Schema').item.json.userId || "" }}', '') AS uid,
         NULLIF('{{ $('Validate Request Schema').item.json.guestId || "" }}', '') AS gid
), upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO guest_sessions (id, expires_at)
  SELECT gid::uuid, now() + interval '1 day' FROM input
  WHERE uid IS NULL AND gid ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
  RETURNING id::text AS resolved
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT resolved FROM upserted),
                (SELECT uid FROM input)) AS user_id,
       (SELECT uid FROM input) IS NOT NULL AS authenticated;

=-- N8N-008: record engine, provider mode, latency, and fallback state.
INSERT INTO recommendation_sessions (request_id, intent, request_context, engine_used, fallback_used, status, latency_ms)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Normalize Subworkflow Result').item.json.requestId }}',
  '{{ $('Normalize Subworkflow Result').item.json.intent }}',
  '{}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $('Normalize Subworkflow Result').item.json.engine }}',
  {{ $('Normalize Subworkflow Result').item.json.fallbackUsed }},
  'completed',
  {{ $('Normalize Subworkflow Result').item.json.latencyMs }}
)
RETURNING id::text;
